Absolution

Please help support the mission of New Advent and get the full contents of this website as an instant download.

The term absolution refers to the remission of sins granted in the sacrament of penance by a duly authorized priest.

The power of absolution was granted by Christ to his apostles and their successors through the words recorded in John 20:23.
